add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__)

include_directories(${VKD3D_INCLUDE_DIRS})

spec2def(d3d8.dll d3d8.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# d3d8.dll is all Rust (d3d8-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/d3d8-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(d3d8_shims OBJECT
    # buffer.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/d3d8-rust/src/d3d8/buffer.rs)
    # d3d8_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/d3d8-rust/src/d3d8/d3d8_main.rs)
    # device.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/d3d8-rust/src/d3d8/device.rs)
    # directx.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/d3d8-rust/src/d3d8/directx.rs)
    # shader.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/d3d8-rust/src/d3d8/shader.rs)
    # surface.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/d3d8-rust/src/d3d8/surface.rs)
    # swapchain.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/d3d8-rust/src/d3d8/swapchain.rs)
    # texture.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/d3d8-rust/src/d3d8/texture.rs)
    # vertexdeclaration.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/d3d8-rust/src/d3d8/vertexdeclaration.rs)
    # volume.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/d3d8-rust/src/d3d8/volume.rs)
    rust_cohab_stub.c
    )
target_link_libraries(d3d8_shims PRIVATE wine dxguid uuid libd3dwine libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(d3d8_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_wine_module(d3d8_shims)
add_dependencies(d3d8_shims wineheaders d3d_idl_headers)
add_cargo_module(d3d8 d3d8-cargo d3d8.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE d3d8-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS d3d8_shims psdk uuid_sources)
